article.title: Effect of accepting performance from third person.
article.content:
41Effect of accepting performance from third person.

Section 41  ·  Chapter IV  ·  By whom contracts must be performed  ·  page 22 of the Act
When a promisee accepts performance of the promise from a third person, he cannot afterwards enforce it against the promisor.
